implementations.healthy: export const run = ({ capacity, occupied, quantity }) => quantity > 0 && occupied + quantity <= capacity ? capacity - occupied - quantity : null;
implementations.primary-fault: export const run = ({ capacity, occupied, quantity }) => quantity > 0 && quantity <= capacity ? capacity - occupied - quantity : null;
implementations.secondary-fault: export const run = ({ capacity, occupied, quantity }) => occupied + quantity <= capacity ? capacity - occupied - quantity : null;

assertions.partial:
assert.equal(run({ capacity: 5, occupied: 2, quantity: 3 }), 0);
  assert.equal(run({ capacity: 5, occupied: 4, quantity: 2 }), null);
assertions.tautological: const input = { capacity: 5, occupied: 4, quantity: 2 }; assert.equal(run(input), run(input));

implementations.healthy: export const run = ({ lines, discountBps }) => Math.round(lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.cents * line.quantity, 0) * (10000 - discountBps) / 10000);
implementations.primary-fault: export const run = ({ lines, discountBps }) => Math.round(lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.cents, 0) * (10000 - discountBps) / 10000);
implementations.secondary-fault: export const run = ({ lines, discountBps }) => Math.floor(lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.cents * line.quantity, 0) * (10000 - discountBps) / 10000);

assertions.tautological: const input = { lines: [{ cents: 105, quantity: 3 }], discountBps: 5000 }; assert.equal(run(input), run(input));
